_comment: Scenario dimensions for the Germany50 SNDlib topology as emitted by genera_lab.py. Deploy this to /etc/ipa/topology_config.json on each node, or point $IPA_TOPOLOGY_CONFIG at it. The engine has no built-in values: these numbers used to live as DEFAULT_TOPOLOGY_CONFIG inside model_meta.py.
_n_interfaces_note: Largest node degree in the network, NOT this node's degree. karlsruhe reaches 6 once h_src is attached; the rest range from 2 to 6 and pad the unused link_state slots with zeros.
_n_queues_note: Declared for completeness. The checked-in model's feature descriptor has no queue_occupancy feature, so nothing reads this.
